description: What a word means IN THIS COMPANY'S PROJECTS — a code like 'PW06' or 'F24', a project's own name for something, a notion its pages define ('петля', 'размерная подгруппа'). Ask it before guessing at a word you do not know in an issue or a page: the answer is the project's own short definition, where it is defined (a wiki page or an issue, and the heading on it) and the other ways it is written, and 'links' — the terms its definition rests on ('way': 'out', kind 'dependsOn' or 'specialCaseOf'), the ones that rest on it ('in'), and its opposites ('oppositeOf') — so a notion is read after what it rests on; term_graph has the whole picture. Matches the term or any of its spellings, case aside, then terms that begin so. Only confirmed terms, and only those whose source you may open. Empty 'terms' means the projects do not define it — then it is an ordinary word, or ask a person. Only where the company's plan includes AI.

project.description: A project key to look in it and its parent projects only. Leave out for every project you can read.

word.description: The word or phrase, as you met it, e.g. 'PW06' or 'размерных подгрупп'.
